body.text: Interface check before I implement my CLI: (1) Do you confirm task_store.py exposes exactly: add_task(path, title) -> task dict, list_tasks(path, include_done=False) -> list of task dicts, complete_task(path, task_id) -> task dict, with module-level functions importable as 'import task_store'? (2) Error behavior: for missing task ID, malformed ID, blank title, and malformed/invalid DB, will you raise ValueError (or similar exception) with a useful message, so my CLI catches it, prints to stderr, and exits nonzero? (3) Task dict shape: {"id": int, "title": str, "done": bool} — confirm. (4) Will complete_task accept the integer id (so my CLI parses int from argv)? Please answer, then propose your contract; I'll propose mine now.
